acceptance: TestPyPI rehearsal evidence: tag, run URL, hashes equal to queue run
PyPI release evidence: run URL, hashes, attestation, install checks green
context: muse M6: legacy release path retirement waits for this item.
description:
DECISION GATE. Release freeze (G7) is in force from the start of dlv2-40 until this item finishes; the legacy release path remains the fallback throughout.
1. release-prep a pre-release version, queue it, sign the tag, run release-v2 to TestPyPI; record that published hashes equal the queue-run hashes and that pip install from TestPyPI works on all T4 cells.
2. Owner decides go/no-go.
3. Ship the next real release via release-v2 to PyPI; verify hashes, attestation, and pypi-latest installability (nightly t3:install).
